task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:
You're now in the kitchen.

You can make out a closed fridge here. You can see a closed oven. You make out a table. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a counter. On the counter you can make out a red apple, a banana, a cookbook and a knife.
